# MyMzansi Style Dictionary

**Version** 1.0.0 · **Status** proposal · **Tokens** 135 · **Generated** 2026-08-15

> Unofficial concept work. Not endorsed by the Presidency Digital Services Unit.

Every token, its value, and what it is called on each platform. Source of truth: [`tokens.json`](../tokens.json). Rules and rationale: [`BRAND.md`](../BRAND.md).

**Never reference `color.palette.*` from a component** — use a theme or semantic token so light and dark resolve on their own (BRAND.md §3.1).

> **R2 — the maize rule.** Maize is 1.44:1 on the light ground. In light theme it is a **ground, never a mark**. Ink on maize is 11.1:1 (AAA); on the dark ground maize is unrestricted at 11.36:1.

## Motion

Only `transform` and `opacity` may be animated — 16.7ms frame budget on an entry-level handset.

### duration
| Token | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `instant` | `100ms` | Maximum acceptable latency before a tap shows feedback. |
| `quick` | `180ms` | Micro-interactions: toggles, chips, hover. |
| `base` | `280ms` | Default. Most state changes. |
| `slow` | `380ms` | Entrances, expansions, meters. |
| `deliberate` | `1100ms` | RESERVED for the verification moment only. No other use. |

### easing
| Token | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `standard` | `0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1` | Default. Fast out, settles gently. |
| `overshoot` | `0.2, 1.5, 0.4, 1` | Confirmation only. One overshoot, never a bounce loop. |
| `exit` | `0.4, 0, 1, 1` | Leaving the screen. Accelerate away. |

### stagger
| Token | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `interval` | `45ms` |  |
| `maxTotal` | `300ms` | HARD CAP regardless of item count. Compute interval as min(45ms, 300ms / itemCount). |
